downloaded on 2026-11-25 (Europe/Kyiv), SHA-256

Used for offline tests. Coverage is one tile and only the extract area is complete.

The Kyiv, Warsaw and Shehyni–Medyka Light/Dark fixtures are derived from separate
small OSM extracts under the same ODbL terms. See [europe-samples.json](europe-samples.json)
for the per-extract URLs, bounds, hashes and dates. Reproduce with
`python scripts/road-map-pilot.py /tmp/trackium-road-pilot` from the repository root.
